title: A silver glow in the woods
B: Gail sees a silver light in the woods.
She looks through the trees.
C: Deep in the magical woods, Gail spots a silver glow.
She peeks through the tall trees, wondering what is shining ahead.
zhB: 瑜瑜在樹林裡看見銀白色的光。
zhC: 在魔法森林深處，瑜瑜看見一道銀白色的微光。
她穿過高聳的樹木，好奇前面究竟是什麼在發光。

title: A little unicorn rushes by
B: A little unicorn runs down the path.
His mane shines as he runs.
C: Suddenly, a little unicorn rushes down the path!
He gallops fast with a sparkly white mane, nearly bumping into Gail.
zhB: 一隻小獨角獸沿著小路跑來。
他的鬃毛跑動時閃閃發亮。
zhC: 突然，一隻小獨角獸急忙沿著小路奔跑過來！
他甩著亮晶晶的白鬃毛飛奔，差點撞上了瑜瑜。

title: I know the way!
B: Gail asks, “Are you lost?”
“No, I know the way!” he says.
C: “Are you lost?” Gail asks gently.
“No! I know the way!” the little unicorn replies with a proud smile.
zhC: 「你迷路了嗎？」瑜瑜輕聲詢問。
「沒有！我知道路！」小獨角獸自豪地微笑回答。

title: The journey home
B: The unicorn is Lumi.
He wants to go home to Moonlight Meadow.
C: His name is Lumi, and he needs to return to Moonlight Meadow.
Gail wants to help, so she offers to walk beside him.
zhB: 他想回到月光草原的家。
zhC: 他的名字叫 Lumi，正要回到月光草原。
瑜瑜想幫忙，於是提議陪他一起走。

title: The first crossroads
B: The path splits in two.
Gail looks at the sign, but Lumi turns left.
C: Soon, the trail splits into two different paths.
Gail wants to read the wooden signpost, but Lumi dashes to the left.
“This way!” he shouts.
zhB: 瑜瑜看路標，Lumi 卻往左轉。
zhC: 不久，小路分成了左右兩條岔路。
瑜瑜想看木頭路標，Lumi 卻立刻衝向左邊。
「走這邊！」他大喊。

title: The giant mushroom grove
B: They walk into a grove of giant mushrooms.
The path grows hard to see.
C: They step into a strange grove filled with giant mushrooms.
The air smells sweet, but the path seems to fade away.
“It is just a shortcut,” Lumi insists.
zhB: 他們走進長滿巨大蘑菇的樹林。
zhC: 他們走進一片長滿巨大蘑菇的奇特樹林。
空氣中飄著甜甜的氣味，但小路似乎消失了。
「這只是捷徑啦。」Lumi 堅持說道。

title: Unicorns do not need maps!
B: They reach another fork.
Gail takes out a map, but Lumi says no.
C: They reach another fork surrounded by twisting branches.
Gail pulls a colorful map out of her bag.
“Unicorns do not need maps!” Lumi declares boldly.
zhB: 瑜瑜拿出地圖，Lumi 卻說不要。
zhC: 他們來到另一個被盤根錯節樹枝環繞的岔路。
瑜瑜從包包裡拿出一張彩色的地圖。
「獨角獸才不需要地圖呢！」Lumi 大膽宣稱。

title: Walking in circles
B: They walk for a long time.
Then they see the same crooked tree.
C: They walk and walk under the leafy canopy.
Suddenly, they find themselves staring at the very same crooked tree!
They have walked in a big circle.
zhB: 接著又看見同一棵歪歪的樹。
zhC: 他們在濃密的樹蔭下一走再走。
突然，他們發現自己竟又站在同一棵歪歪的大樹前！
他們繞了一大圈又走回了原地。

title: Gail spots a clue
B: Gail sees a mark on the tree.
“We have been here,” she says.
C: “We have been here before,” Gail points out the mark on the bark.
Lumi stops trotting, and his ears begin to droop nervously.
zhC: 「我們剛剛來過這裡。」瑜瑜指著樹皮上的痕跡。
Lumi 停下腳步，耳朵緊張地垂了下來。

title: The woodland rabbit
B: A friendly rabbit crosses their path.
Gail wants to ask, but Lumi walks on.
C: A friendly woodland rabbit hops across their path.
Gail wants to ask for directions, but Lumi hurries past.
“I already know where to go!” he says quickly.
zhB: 瑜瑜想問路，Lumi 卻繼續走。
zhC: 一隻友善的森林小兔子跳過他們面前。
瑜瑜想開口問路，但 Lumi 卻匆忙跑了過去。
「我早就知道該怎麼走了！」他急忙說。

title: The rushing river
B: A wide river blocks the path.
There is no bridge to cross.
C: The trees clear, and a wide, rushing river blocks their way.
There is no bridge, and the water is far too deep to cross.
This time, Lumi cannot say a single word.
zhC: 穿過樹林，一條奔流的大河擋住了他們的去路。
這裡沒有橋樑，河水太深無法跨越。
這一次，Lumi 一句話也說不出來了。

title: Sunset in the forest
B: The sun goes down behind the hills.
The woods grow dark.
C: The sun begins to set behind the rolling hills.
Long purple shadows stretch across the grass, and the forest grows cold and dark.
zhC: 太陽漸漸落入起伏的山巒之後。
長長的紫色影子在草地上蔓延，森林變得寒冷又昏暗。

title: The truth at last
B: Gail asks Lumi if he knows where they are.
“I do not know,” he says.
C: Gail sits beside Lumi and asks softly, “Lumi, do you know where we are?”
Lumi looks down at his hooves.
“I... I don't know,” he whispers honestly.
zhB: 瑜瑜問 Lumi 知不知道自己在哪裡。
zhC: 瑜瑜坐在 Lumi 身邊，溫柔地問：「Lumi，你知道我們在哪裡嗎？」
Lumi 看著自己的小蹄子。
「我……我不知道。」他誠實地小聲說。

title: It is okay not to know
B: Gail sits beside Lumi.
“It is okay. We can find out together.”
C: Gail smiles warmly and pats his silver mane.
“It is okay not to know,” she says. “We can find out together!”
zhB: 瑜瑜坐在 Lumi 身邊。
zhC: 瑜瑜溫暖地微笑，輕拍他銀白色的鬃毛。
「不知道也沒關係呀，」她說：「我們可以一起找出答案！」

title: Reading the map together
B: They look at the map on the ground.
They find the river, mountain, and moon.
C: They sit together and spread out the map on the mossy ground.
They match the curved river, the tall mountain, and the rising moon.
Now the clues make sense!
zhB: 他們看攤在地上的地圖。
zhC: 他們坐在一起，將地圖攤在長滿青苔的地面上。
他們對照著彎彎的河流、高高的山峰和升起的月亮。
現在線索全都清楚了！

title: Asking for help
B: Lumi asks the rabbit for help.
The rabbit points to the glowing flowers.
C: They walk back to find the friendly rabbit.
This time, Lumi speaks up politely: “Excuse me, can you help us find the way?”
The rabbit happily wiggles his nose and points toward the glowing flowers.
zhC: 他們走回去找剛才那隻友善的小兔子。
這一次，Lumi 很有禮貌地開口：「請問，你可以幫我們指路嗎？」
小兔子開心地動動鼻子，指著發光的花朵方向。

title: Glowing moon flowers
B: The flowers light a little path.
Gail and Lumi follow them home.
C: Following the rabbit’s directions, they discover shimmering moon flowers along the trail.
Their soft petals glow in the dark, lighting up the secret path home.
zhB: 瑜瑜和 Lumi 沿著它回家。
zhC: 順著兔子的指引，他們在小徑旁發現了閃閃發光的月亮花。
柔和的花瓣在黑暗中發光，照亮了通往家的祕密小徑。

title: Moonlight Meadow
B: They come to Moonlight Meadow.
Lumi’s family is waiting there.
C: They step out of the dense woods into the sparkling Moonlight Meadow!
A herd of unicorns welcomes Lumi home with joyful nickers.
zhC: 他們走出茂密的樹林，踏進了波光粼粼的月光草原！
獨角獸家族歡喜地輕鳴，熱情迎接 Lumi 回家。

title: I asked for help!
B: Lumi’s mother asks how he got home.
“I asked for help!” says Lumi.
C: His mother nuzzles him and asks, “How did you find your way back?”
Lumi smiles brightly and says, “I asked for help!”
zhB: Lumi 的媽媽問他怎麼回來。
zhC: 媽媽親暱地蹭著他問：「你是怎麼找到回家的路呢？」
Lumi 開心地燦笑著說：「因為我主動求助了！」

title: Stop, look, and ask!
A: Ask for help when you need it.
B: It is okay not to know.
Stop, look, and ask for help.
C: Don't know? That is okay!
Stop, look, and ask—and you will always find your way!
zhC: 不知道嗎？沒關係！
停下來、仔細看、開口問——你一定能找到方向！
